tasks.userFacingSummary: Tool cache keyed on tree content, not HEAD+worktree path: same tree shares results across worktrees and commits
Failed-first reruns: record failing test files in the cache entry and re-run only those first after a fix
Tool cache: never reuse a resource-killed result; key on the effective heap and worker env (NODE_OPTIONS etc.)
Map cleo-nexus #24's new 403 reasons (device-flow-session-required, device-not-enrolled) to typed errors with a cleo login fix
tool:test is scope-aware: run affected packages when testing.affectedCommand is set, full suite only when root config changed
cleo complete resolves ci:<pr> itself instead of demanding a local full run after merge (reconcile T12656)
Targeted test-run evidence bound to HEAD, tree hash and covered files
Snapshot vault protocol: E2E encryption key hierarchy, per-device generation lineage, plaintext minimal manifest, recovery key
CLI: cleo cloud push | pull | restore (snapshot vault), on top of the shipped login/logout/status/devices/projects
cleo cloud verify: compare this machine's checkpoint and checksums with the server and other devices
cleo cloud activity: which device changed what, and when (E18/E19)
Vault pull/restore must never wipe this machine's credentials (sessions owner_auth_token, agent credentials, global account/registry/service secrets)
Vault manifest and restore honour column-level local-only classes (nexus_project_registry paths etc.)
Vault global scope excludes machine identity and runtime state (device-id, state/, keys/, runtime files, nexus.db, config home)
Vault up-to-date and local-changes checks cover the whole bundle (docs blobs, attachments, config), not just cleo.db
Vault wording and trust: say 'encrypted, key escrowed on Cleo Nexus', not end-to-end; document what escrow gives up
Vault lease: release after a successful or up-to-date push; up-to-date never takes the lease
Vault state file: never silently reset trust; refuse or move aside unparseable/newer files; write under a lock
Vault restore takes the store's exclusive guard before replacing a live store (no lost writes from daemons/sessions)
Vault read paths stay read-only: global vault/verify never bind a replica; pull/restore never mint or escrow keys
Vault push: a segment landing mid-push maps to BEHIND (retry), not REFUSED
Vault LOW follow-ups from #1773 review: refusal exit codes, restore --project into another project's store, stale fork warning, brittle relink hint
Vault pull/restore propagates deletions: files and databases the snapshot no longer lists are removed (#1773 r3 N1)
Vault pull never silently overwrites unhashed local files (config.json, project-context.json, worktrees.json, dotfiles) (#1773 r3 N2)
Vault placeholder registry rows (cleo-vault-remote:) never reach store openers (#1773 r3 N3)
Vault LOWs from #1773 r3: persistent fork label, pusher-local state on fresh restore, crash after checkpoint, untrusted verify, exit codes (#1773 r3 N4-N6)
Vault never places over or removes git-tracked .cleo/ paths in a git checkout; git syncs them (#1773 r4 R1)
Vault restore never deletes never-synced local files without --force when the store has no synced rows (#1773 r4 R2/R3)
Vault placeholder rows: reject cleo-vault-remote: paths before resolve() and skip remote rows in workspace and registry-roots (#1773 r4 N3 remainder)
Vault LOWs from #1773 r4: global CLEO-installed content, config key order, installId, project-info.json, tree_id carry (#1773 r4 R4/R5)
Vault git-tracked marks never hide local edits: per-path digests without git, no marks for global scope, marks converge across checkouts (#1773 r5 R5-1/R5-2)
cleo run --class <test|build|typecheck|install|scan> [--scope] -- <cmd>: governed heavy-command front door (cleo-nexus lead)
E_RESOURCE_DEFERRED soft-stop LAFS envelope: queue position, ETA, holders, ways forward (cache hit, ci:<pr>, narrower scope, --wait) (cleo-nexus lead)
Darwin pressure backend for ResourceMonitor (kern.memorystatus_level, vm_stat/compressor, loadavg, per-process RSS) feeding pressureScaleSlots; yellow narrows, red pauses heavy jobs (cleo-nexus lead)
cleo run: orphan recovery never group-signals a nested (non-leader) job record (#1777 r5 N3)
cleo run fails open: governor I/O errors run the command ungoverned with a notice (#1781 HIGH-2)
Provider hooks route heavy commands through cleo run (Claude Code PreToolUse Bash rewrite + pressure context line; Codex/Kimi/opencode adapters where hooks exist)
Heavy-command hook wraps the heavy element in place, never via sh -c (#1781 HIGH-1)
Agent instructions: CI-first + affected evidence; drop 'pnpm run test then tool:test' (injection, spawn prompt, ct-task-executor/ct-orchestrator/ct-ivt-looper, CLEO-REFERENCE)
Worker re-verification uses the worker's evidence or affected tests, never a blind full suite (worker-verify.ts, sentient daemon)
Machine-wide heavy-run admission on macOS: governor test-run class wired into runToolCached; darwin default 1 test slot
Evidence ergonomics: test-affected in valid tool names and help, cleo verify --fresh, done-record passes executionRoot
cleocode mirror of cleo-nexus segment/v3 + checkpoint/v3: vault verifies v3 checkpoints/segments and handles a v3-ratcheted stream (cleo-nexus #30 MED-1)

## v2026.10.2 — 2026-10-02

### Added

- cleo cloud push, pull, restore, verify, vault, lease release and activity back up and recover project and global stores as encrypted snapshots on Cleo Nexus (the key is escrowed on Cleo Nexus, released only to your approved devices), with lineage, a single-writer lease, verified restore that keeps this machine's own state and credentials, and a per-device integrity check; cleo login nexus also hands the device the encryption key and attaches its global store. Requires a Cleo Nexus server with account key escrow (cleo-nexus T082) and, for the global store, home replicas (cleo-nexus T084); against an older server the vault commands fail without writing anything (their errors do not yet name the missing server feature: reads report an empty vault), and login still succeeds, with a warning that the global store was not attached _(provenance: [T12336](https://github.com/kryptobaseddev/cleo/search?q=T12336&type=commits), [T12337](https://github.com/kryptobaseddev/cleo/search?q=T12337&type=commits), - Agent instructions recommend cleo done --plan, ci:<pr> after merge and tool:test-affected before it; worker re-verification runs affected tests first in the worker's (or adopted) worktree, and a busy test slot costs no attempt; heavy tool runs take a governor slot and default to one machine-wide slot on macOS; a governor or tool slot whose holder process and tool are both gone is reaped at once, and a terminating signal is passed on to running tools; cleo verify --fresh; test-affected is a listed tool name. _(provenance: [T12957](https://github.com/kryptobaseddev/cleo/search?q=T12957&type=commits), [T12962](https://github.com/kryptobaseddev/cleo/search?q=T12962&type=commits), [T12963](https://github.com/kryptobaseddev/cleo/search?q=T12963&type=commits), [T12964](https://github.com/kryptobaseddev/cleo/search?q=T12964&type=commits))_
- tool:test runs affected packages first, cleo complete resolves ci:<pr> itself after merge, test-run evidence is bound to fresh, relevant reports and its tree _(provenance: [T12959](https://github.com/kryptobaseddev/cleo/search?q=T12959&type=commits), [T12960](https://github.com/kryptobaseddev/cleo/search?q=T12960&type=commits), [T12965](https://github.com/kryptobaseddev/cleo/search?q=T12965&type=commits), [T12656](https://github.com/kryptobaseddev/cleo/search?q=T12656&type=commits))_
- cleo run: the governed front door for heavy commands, with a machine-wide budget per class, a soft stop (E_RESOURCE_DEFERRED, exit 75), pause-instead-of-kill under pressure, a macOS pressure backend and --passthrough for the provider hook _(provenance: [T12979](https://github.com/kryptobaseddev/cleo/search?q=T12979&type=commits), [T12980](https://github.com/kryptobaseddev/cleo/search?q=T12980&type=commits), [T12981](https://github.com/kryptobaseddev/cleo/search?q=T12981&type=commits); [#1777](https://github.com/kryptobaseddev/cleo/pull/1777))_
- a provider hook that CLEO installs routes agents' heavy shell commands (tests, builds, typechecks, installs) through `cleo run`, so agents share one machine-wide budget without being told to _(provenance: [T12983](https://github.com/kryptobaseddev/cleo/search?q=T12983&type=commits))_
- Cloud vault reads segment/v3 and checkpoint/v3, refuses to push onto a v3 stream, and stamps a shared SYNC_SCHEMA_VERSION _(provenance: [T13034](https://github.com/kryptobaseddev/cleo/search?q=T13034&type=commits))_
- the evidence tool cache is keyed on source tree content plus an environment fingerprint, so equally built worktrees and commits with the same content share one run and concurrent identical runs coalesce; a failing `tool:test` is re-run in full once (a pass then is marked `flaky`) and, after a change, re-runs only its failing files first _(provenance: [T12958](https://github.com/kryptobaseddev/cleo/search?q=T12958&type=commits), [T12961](https://github.com/kryptobaseddev/cleo/search?q=T12961&type=commits))_

### Changed

- store migrations run through CLEO's own bracketed runner: one transaction per migration file, and a foreign-key orphan that already existed never blocks a migration; the sync journal's change capture ships switched off (sync.capture) _(provenance: [#1778](https://github.com/kryptobaseddev/cleo/pull/1778))_

### Fixed

- the evidence tool cache never reuses a run that was killed for resources (an OOM, a heap limit, exit 137/143, a signal), and its key now includes the heap and worker limits the run was spawned with, so a retry with more memory always runs _(provenance: [T12989](https://github.com/kryptobaseddev/cleo/search?q=T12989&type=commits))_
- Cleo Nexus refusals `device-flow-session-required` and `device-not-enrolled` now report a typed error with a `cleo login nexus` fix instead of a bare server message _(provenance: [T13008](https://github.com/kryptobaseddev/cleo/search?q=T13008&type=commits))_
